description: List all tags assigned to a specific Zendesk user. Use when you need to see what tags are associated with a particular user for organizing, filtering, or categorizing user data. This action is read-only and idempotent.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for listing tags for a specific Zendesk user.

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the user whose tags to retrieve. This is the user ID found in ticket payloads (requester_id, submitter_id, assignee_id, author_id).
user_id.title: User Id

inputSchema.title: GetUsersTagsRequest

name: get_users_tags

GetUsersTagsResponse.description: Response containing the list of tags assigned to a Zendesk user.

tags.description: An array of tag strings assigned to the user. Tags are used to categorize and organize users in Zendesk.
tags.title: Tags

GetUsersTagsResponse.title: GetUsersTagsResponse
